Based on my search of all documents in the data room (including every supplier agreement in docs/suppliers/, plus a broader search across all docs), no file contains a most-favoured-nation (MFN) pricing clause, nor any related language ("most favoured/favored nation," "MFN," "best price," "no less favorable," etc.).

The supplier agreements' pricing clauses (Clause 6 in each) only reference either "fixed prices, not indexed" (e.g., supplier-agreement-dunmore.docx, and numbered agreements 005–120) or "an indexed price cap... capped at four percent" (supplier-agreement-acme.docx, supplier-agreement-borealis.docx, supplier-agreement-corvid.docx) — none describe an MFN pricing guarantee.

NOT FOUND — I searched all supplier agreement documents (docs/suppliers/*.docx) and the full docs folder for "most favoured/favored nation," "MFN," and related pricing-parity phrasing, and found no such clause in any agreement.
